source.name: Sports Business Journal, 'Health care providers, financial companies dominate NFL jersey patches'
source.quote: As of Sept. 9, the Raiders and Steelers again had yet to sign a jersey sponsor for this season, and the Vikings had not replaced Pepsi's previous five-year partnership.

note: Practice-jersey patch (the only on-uniform sponsor placement the NFL allows). Start unknown, so 'from' is null; the patch was on Vikings practice jerseys at 2024 training camp (vikings.com, 2024-07-29) and Zoomph listed Pepsi as the Vikings' jersey patch partner for the 2025 season. PepsiCo separately extended its broader Vikings partnership through the 2031 NFL season (vikings.com, 2025-03-31), but SBJ reports the jersey-patch element as a previous, five-year partnership that had not been replaced in 2026. Star Tribune (2022-01-08) says Training Haus, not Pepsi, became the practice-jersey partner in 2021 — the start of the Pepsi patch is unclear, and the two accounts disagree.
